subject: Important Appointment Information – Dr. Irfan Lalani
snippet:
To Patients:
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT IT IS MANDATORY FOR YOU TO COMPLETE THE PATIENT PORTAL FOR DR. LALANI’S OFFICE PRIOR TO YOUR APPOINTMENT.  YOU WILL RECEIVE A TEXT MESSAGE ON YOUR MOBILE PHONE TO SET UP THE PORTAL.  IF THIS DATA IS NOT SUBMITTED, THIS MAY RESULT IN US HAVING TO RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOI
